Profile.title: Profile
Profile.subtitle: Information visible to other Lenix users.
Profile.verified_desc: Level 2 access and higher withdrawal limits.
Profile.toast_invalid_image: Please upload a PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or GIF image.

Preferences.title: Preferences
Preferences.subtitle: Customize your display and notification settings.

Security.title: Security & Privacy
Security.subtitle: Manage your account protection and data privacy settings.
Security.two_factor_desc: Add an extra layer of security to your account by requiring a code from your phone.
Security.biometric_subtitle: Use FaceID or TouchID to unlock your Lenix Wallet.
Security.auto_lock_subtitle: Automatically lock the app after 5 minutes of inactivity.
Security.recovery_phrase_desc: If you lose your recovery phrase, you lose access to your funds forever. Never share it with anyone, including Lenix employees.

Advanced.title: Advanced Settings
Advanced.subtitle: Technical configurations for advanced users and developers.
Advanced.dev_mode_desc: Show testnets and advanced debugging info.
Advanced.gas_analytics_desc: Show detailed gas breakdown for every transaction.
Advanced.reset_account_desc: Clears all transaction history and cached data. Your funds will remain safe on the blockchain.
Advanced.delete_account_desc: Permanently delete your Lenix account and all associated data. This action is irreversible.

Contacts.title: Contacts
Contacts.subtitle: Manage your frequently used wallet addresses.
Contacts.no_contacts_desc: Try a different search term or add a new contact.
Contacts.info_desc: Lenix uses an advanced address book to help you avoid sending funds to the wrong address. Favorite contacts appear at the top of your send list.

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.subtitle: Choose which updates you want to receive and how.
Notifications.allow_push_desc: Receive real-time alerts on your device.
Notifications.price_alerts_desc: Get notified about significant market moves.
Notifications.product_updates_desc: Stay informed about new features and improvements.
Notifications.marketing_news_desc: Tips, offers, and crypto market insights.

Networks.title: Networks
Networks.subtitle: Add and manage the blockchain networks you use with Lenix.
Networks.search_placeholder: Search by name, symbol, or chain ID...
Networks.testnets_desc: Enable Developer Mode in Advanced settings to view and manage test networks.
Networks.security_desc: A malicious network provider can track your activity and provide false information about the state of the blockchain. Only add networks you trust.

About.title: About Lenix
About.disclaimer: Lenix Wallet is a decentralized non-custodial wallet. You are solely responsible for your funds and recovery phrase.
